name: MuRAG
representation_path: joint image/text embeddings -> raw image patches and text
selection_and_integration: MIPS top-k; encoder-decoder conditioning
execution_phase_and_learning: training and inference; multimodal pretraining and task fine-tuning
evaluation_contract: WebQA full-wiki and distractor settings; MultimodalQA subset; retrieval and task scores
source_observation: The paper distinguishes retrieval settings and reports visual counting/recognition errors in a manually inspected sample.
reviewer_inference_limit: A full-pipeline gain cannot isolate retrieval from pretraining or visual reading.
audit_scope: Named configuration and cited passages; not an exhaustive annotation of every experiment or a reproduction.

name: FLMR / RA-VQA-v2
representation_path: visual/text query tokens -> retrieved text passages
selection_and_integration: late-interaction ranking; T5 or BLIP-2 answer generation
execution_phase_and_learning: training and inference in RA-VQA; aligned retriever and task-trained consumer
evaluation_contract: OK-VQA; Google Search and Wikipedia collections; PRRecall and VQA score
passage_locators: Sections 3-5; Tables 1-4; Appendix H; PDF pp.4-9,19
source_observation: Visual query features can retrieve textual evidence; the main retrieval metric is pseudo-relevance based.
reviewer_inference_limit: PRRecall based on answer-bearing passages is not an independently annotated sufficient-support measure.
audit_scope: Named configuration and cited passages; not an exhaustive annotation of every experiment or a reproduction.

name: SURf
representation_path: CLIP image embeddings -> retrieved images and captions
selection_and_integration: top-N image retrieval; selective-use instruction fine-tuning
execution_phase_and_learning: training and inference; LLaVA-1.5 instruction fine-tuning
evaluation_contract: POPE, MMStar, VizWiz-VQA, COCO, VizWiz-Caption, CIFAR-10, EmoSet; irrelevant-pair and switching tests
source_observation: Published perturbation tests separate low-relevance content from mismatched image-caption pairs.
reviewer_inference_limit: Changes include consumer training; robustness gains do not identify a better retriever alone.
audit_scope: Named configuration and cited passages; not an exhaustive annotation of every experiment or a reproduction.

name: VisRAG
information_source: external document-page pool assembled from dataset pages
representation_path: VLM pooled page embedding -> page image
selection_and_integration: dual-encoder cosine ranking; page concatenation, weighted answer selection, or multi-image reader
execution_phase_and_learning: inference retrieval; contrastively trained retriever, pretrained reader variants
evaluation_contract: six document-VQA sources; MRR@10 and generation accuracy; generator-dependent top-k comparisons
source_observation: The page image is retained for reading; retrieval and generation are evaluated separately.
reviewer_inference_limit: Whole-pipeline OCR/image comparisons alter more than the ranking function; preserving pixels does not establish correct reading.
audit_scope: Named configuration and cited passages; not an exhaustive annotation of every experiment or a reproduction.

name: M3DocRAG
information_source: external cross-document pool and supplied-document variants
representation_path: ColPali/ColQwen page multi-vectors -> page images
selection_and_integration: MaxSim; optional approximate index; multimodal QA
execution_phase_and_learning: inference retrieval; plug-in pretrained retrievers and readers
evaluation_contract: M3DocVQA: 2441 questions,3368 PDFs,41005 pages; MMLongBench-Doc and MP-DocVQA are separate settings
source_observation: One architecture is evaluated under both cross-corpus and within-document candidate spaces.
reviewer_inference_limit: Those settings require separate configuration records; the text baseline also uses a different reader.
audit_scope: Named configuration and cited passages; not an exhaustive annotation of every experiment or a reproduction.

name: VideoRAG (Jeong et al.)
representation_path: visual and textual video representations -> selected frames with text
selection_and_integration: video retrieval plus query-guided downstream frame selection
execution_phase_and_learning: inference retrieval; frame scorer trained using sampled RAG outcomes
evaluation_contract: HowTo100M retrieval with WikiHowQA and synthetic HowTo100M QA; ROUGE-L,BLEU-4,BERTScore,G-Eval and retrieval recall
source_observation: Corpus-video retrieval and frame selection within a retrieved video are separate operations.
reviewer_inference_limit: Query-guided frame selection does not turn the candidate corpus into a supplied-video benchmark.
audit_scope: Named configuration and cited passages; not an exhaustive annotation of every experiment or a reproduction.

name: Goldfish
information_source: supplied long video indexed into clips
representation_path: clip summaries and subtitles -> selected textual summaries/subtitles
selection_and_integration: text embedding search; LLM answers from selected descriptions
execution_phase_and_learning: inference retrieval; trained MiniGPT4-Video produces summaries
evaluation_contract: TVQA-long; TVR text/vision subsets; retrieval accuracy and QA accuracy
source_observation: Subtitles and summaries have different retrieval utility across the evaluated subsets.
reviewer_inference_limit: Description selection provides access to supplied content; it does not add independently sourced knowledge.
audit_scope: Named configuration and cited passages; not an exhaustive annotation of every experiment or a reproduction.

name: CARVE
representation_path: visual/textual frame/clip embeddings -> winning chunk representation
selection_and_integration: parallel retrieval; chunk-aware reranking and interleaved evidence
execution_phase_and_learning: inference; training-free module in the audited main configuration
evaluation_contract: V-RAGBench:2100 QA triples,216 videos;1800 train/300 test; Recall@5,nDCG@5,LLM-judged pass rate
source_observation: In Table 3, text frame+clip has higher recall than visual frame, but a lower answer pass rate.
reviewer_inference_limit: The result is specific to the stated reader and within-video test; one evidence chunk is annotated, not a general multi-hop support set.
audit_scope: Named configuration and cited passages; not an exhaustive annotation of every experiment or a reproduction.

name: Multimodal Graph RAG / KG4VD
representation_path: page and grounded entity embeddings -> graph facts plus page images
selection_and_integration: page anchors; query-adaptive PPR; reranking; two-stage answering
execution_phase_and_learning: inference retrieval; model-assisted index construction
evaluation_contract: DLVQA:525 QA pairs over3441 pages; FineSurE faithfulness/completeness/conciseness; separate MMLongBench and textual QA tests
source_observation: DLVQA provides supporting facts for document-wide questions; graph and page evidence are integrated.
reviewer_inference_limit: Document-level summary evaluation should not be pooled with single-page QA accuracy; graph construction adds offline cost.
audit_scope: Named configuration and cited passages; not an exhaustive annotation of every experiment or a reproduction.

name: BERAG / BEFT
representation_path: PreFLMR-L text retrieval -> separately conditioned documents
selection_and_integration: token-wise Bayesian ensemble weighting rather than one concatenated context
execution_phase_and_learning: training and inference; BEFT updates consumer
evaluation_contract: E-VQA150K passages/InfoSeek200K passages; Qwen2-VL; Recall@K,BEM,VQA score; context-depth and ordering analyses
source_observation: The retriever is shared across the paper's SFT,DPO,and BEFT variants while answer integration/training differs.
reviewer_inference_limit: Table1 best scores may occur at different K; training and integration effects must be distinguished.
audit_scope: Named configuration and cited passages; not an exhaustive annotation of every experiment or a reproduction.

name: RULE
representation_path: image-similarity retrieval -> report text
selection_and_integration: calibrated context-count selection; knowledge-balance preference tuning
execution_phase_and_learning: training and inference; calibrated retrieval and preference fine-tuning
evaluation_contract: medical VQA over report-derived QA; factuality-risk and accuracy analyses
passage_locators: Sections 3.1-3.3,4.1-4.3; Figure2; main and ablation tables; PDF pp.3-7
source_observation: Retrieval budget and the consumer's reliance on retrieved reports are separate intervention targets.
reviewer_inference_limit: Calibration and task labels constrain the stated risk result; benchmark gains do not establish clinical benefit.
audit_scope: Named configuration and cited passages; not an exhaustive annotation of every experiment or a reproduction.

name: MMed-RAG
representation_path: domain-aware image retrieval -> retrieved report context
selection_and_integration: adaptive context selection; RAG preference fine-tuning
execution_phase_and_learning: training and inference; domain retriever and preference-tuned consumer
evaluation_contract: MIMIC-CXR,IU-Xray,Harvard-FairVLMed,PMC-OA pathology,Quilt-1M; VQA accuracy/F1/AUROC and report BLEU/ROUGE/METEOR
source_observation: The published evaluation separates medical VQA from report generation and ablates several stages.
reviewer_inference_limit: Lexical report metrics and VQA factuality proxies do not imply equivalent clinical accuracy.
audit_scope: Named configuration and cited passages; not an exhaustive annotation of every experiment or a reproduction.

name: SMALLCap robustness study
representation_path: CLIP visual retrieval -> caption text
selection_and_integration: top-k caption prompting; sampled-retrieval training variants
execution_phase_and_learning: training and inference; GPT-2 or OPT decoder variants
evaluation_contract: COCO validation and NoCaps; CIDEr; ordering and relevance perturbations
source_observation: The evaluated SMALLCap variants tolerate caption permutations better than irrelevant captions.
reviewer_inference_limit: Ordering robustness cannot be extrapolated to distractor robustness or all captioners.
audit_scope: Named configuration and cited passages; not an exhaustive annotation of every experiment or a reproduction.

name: ImageRAG
information_source: external image collection; generic LAION350K subset and specialized variants
representation_path: CLIP retrieval-caption matching -> reference image
selection_and_integration: VLM diagnoses missing concepts; existing image-conditioning interface
execution_phase_and_learning: inference; no RAG-specific training in audited base-model applications
evaluation_contract: ImageNet,iNaturalist,CUB; CLIP/DINO/SigLIP,GPTScore and user evaluation; OmniGen,FLUX,SDXL variants
source_observation: Existing image-conditioned generators can use retrieved references without new RAG-specific training.
reviewer_inference_limit: An embedding similarity gain is distinct from rare-concept correctness; each generator/interface is a separate comparison.
audit_scope: Named configuration and cited passages; not an exhaustive annotation of every experiment or a reproduction.

name: Phidias
information_source: external Objaverse40K reference subset; user-reference variant separate
representation_path: image-to-3D reference retrieval -> multiview canonical-coordinate maps
selection_and_integration: meta-ControlNet and dynamic reference routing; sparse-view reconstruction
execution_phase_and_learning: training and inference; curriculum includes self references and retrieved references
evaluation_contract: 200 GSO objects;20 novel views; PSNR,SSIM,LPIPS,CLIP,Chamfer,F-score; retrieved versus GT reference
source_observation: The study explicitly separates retrieved-reference and ground-truth-reference conditions.
reviewer_inference_limit: GT geometry supplies target information and is a conditioning diagnostic, not a fair retrieval baseline.
audit_scope: Named configuration and cited passages; not an exhaustive annotation of every experiment or a reproduction.

name: ReDream
representation_path: semantic asset retrieval -> geometric prior and multiview information
selection_and_integration: retrieval-augmented score distillation; asset-based prior adaptation
execution_phase_and_learning: inference-time optimization and per-query adaptation; pretrained diffusion prior
evaluation_contract: text-to-3D evaluation; CLIP-based scores and user preference; component ablations
source_observation: Retrieved 3D assets affect optimization through geometry and view-consistent prior adaptation.
reviewer_inference_limit: Its per-query optimization cost and output criteria differ from feed-forward document QA.
audit_scope: Named configuration and cited passages; not an exhaustive annotation of every experiment or a reproduction.

name: Embodied-RAG
selected_unit: semantic-forest chain tied to spatial nodes
representation_path: hierarchical language descriptions -> selected chains and waypoints
selection_and_integration: LLM-guided tree traversal; explanation or waypoint generation
execution_phase_and_learning: inference; memory construction from visual observations and odometry
evaluation_contract: Embodied-RAG benchmark; navigation/explanation queries; explicit,implicit,global categories
source_observation: Memory selection operates at several spatial/semantic resolutions and supports different output types.
reviewer_inference_limit: A memory hierarchy is not a calibrated guarantee that observations remain current in a changing environment.
audit_scope: Named configuration and cited passages; not an exhaustive annotation of every experiment or a reproduction.

name: TrajRAG
information_source: accumulated experience from prior navigation episodes
representation_path: geometric-semantic trajectory embeddings -> examples for waypoint reasoning
selection_and_integration: coarse-to-fine experience retrieval; incremental consolidation
execution_phase_and_learning: inference-time retrieval and memory updates; zero-shot ObjectNav
evaluation_contract: HM3Dv1,HM3Dv2,MP3D; success rate and SPL; retrieval/representation ablations
source_observation: Geometric-semantic trajectory experience guides frontier/waypoint decisions.
reviewer_inference_limit: Experience availability and cross-episode evaluation are part of the protocol; SR/SPL is not answer factuality.
audit_scope: Named configuration and cited passages; not an exhaustive annotation of every experiment or a reproduction.

name: mRAG design-space study
representation_path: EVA-CLIP score fusion -> retrieved article context
selection_and_integration: frozen retrieval; reranking; top-document or concatenated generation
execution_phase_and_learning: inference; frozen models in the main design-space comparisons
evaluation_contract: InfoSeek5000/E-VQA4750 cases;50K articles each; Recall@K,MRR,ROUGE-L,model-judged answers
source_observation: Candidate text and generated captions have different effects under the same frozen retriever.
reviewer_inference_limit: The sampled50K corpus is not the full original benchmark; Recall is not answer accuracy.
audit_scope: Named configuration and cited passages; not an exhaustive annotation of every experiment or a reproduction.

name: Retrieval or Representation?
representation_path: alternative OCR/transcriptions -> text page index
selection_and_integration: fixed text retriever while extraction/normalization varies
execution_phase_and_learning: inference; OCR/preprocessing interventions in a retrieval diagnostic
evaluation_contract: 15-language and figure-heavy VisR-Bench; Top-5 evidence-page accuracy
source_observation: Changing extraction with the ranker fixed recovers part of the apparent text/visual retrieval gap.
reviewer_inference_limit: This is a page-retrieval diagnostic; it does not establish downstream QA superiority.
audit_scope: Named configuration and cited passages; not an exhaustive annotation of every experiment or a reproduction.

name: When Good OCR Is Not Enough
selected_unit: OCR text chunks from document pages
representation_path: OCR engines -> one unified RAG pipeline
selection_and_integration: OCR intervention; fixed downstream pipeline
execution_phase_and_learning: inference; compares ten OCR engines across four paradigms
evaluation_contract: 570 documents,11 document types; OCR quality,RAGAS Answer Accuracy and Context Recall; GPT-OSS-120B judge
passage_locators: Sections2.1-2.2,3.1-3.4; Tables1-3; Appendix D; PDF pp.2-6
source_observation: Text recognition, retrieved evidence coverage, and generated answer quality are separately evaluated.
reviewer_inference_limit: Model-judged context recall is not an exhaustive human-annotated support set.
